description.en:
Tells whether a team has a skill effect of a given type among its four team effect entries. It is the team-only half of CMND_BTL_GET_SKILL_EFFECTIVE, except that the value of the effect is not compared: any entry of that type counts.
The "ksn" in its name stands for keshin (Fighting Spirit). The same team entries also hold the type 29 bonus that CMND_BTL_GET_CALC_PARAM applies to Fighting Spirit power.
The result (0 or 1) is written into the output array.
Team to check: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team.
Effect type to look for. ie4_soccer_sys.nut tests types 58 to 62, one per command element 1 to 5.
OUTPUT: result[0] receives 1 if the team has an effect of that type, 0 otherwise.

Always null. The answer comes back in the output array.
Also null, with nothing written, if fewer than 3 arguments are given.

examples.case: A team effect boosting one element (real usage, from ie4_soccer_sys.nut, GetSkillElement)
